text.p: M/A/R/C Group Monday said it board approved a three-for-two stock split in the form of a stock dividend to be distributed on February 28, to shareholders of record at the close of business on February 7.

Shareeholders of the provider of marketing intelligence and related services will receive three shares of common stock for every two shares of the company's stock held on the record date. M/A/R/C Group currently has 3.1 million shares of common stock issued and outstanding.

Separately, the board also approved an 12.5 percent increase in the quarterly dividend. On a post split basis, the new quarterly dividend rate will be $0.075 per share, up from $0.067 per share, and is payable concurrent with the stock dividend to shareholders of record as of the close of business on February 7.
